dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, linear narrowing of the visible body mass from the anterior toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light slate-grey with blue-tinted cool tones, appearing significantly darker than a mature white phenotype.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density distribution of dark pixels concentrated along a thin, vertical longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient at the margins of the central dark-pixel clusters against the lighter grey epidermal background.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A singular, vertical sequence of dark punctate marks resembling a thin rake mark or linear series of punctures on the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a vertical linear series of dark pigmented spots, possibly indicating healed superficial rake marks.
